content.body: In https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#obtain-an-embedder-policy, step 6.2, should the reference to "policy's endpoint" actually be "policy's report only reporting endpoint"? That's where the link goes.
jmdyck: yeah, both should have the full name indeed. Instead of _parsedItem_ using (_value_, _parameters_) might also be an improvement here.
